scope: Read-only local frozen Python source and AST audit only; no model/Torch import, GPU/Driver/NVML/network, codec execution or source mutation.
conditional_stage_E: May be integrated only with actual FP outcome; this audit never upgrades FP or INT8 scientific state.

seven_items.name: H+C128 hook and writeback
seven_items.finding: H transform acts on normalized q/k immediately before native chunk/recurrent helper. C128 quantize reads actual cache state and copies QDQ reconstruction into that same state. Seven shared functions/classes are AST equal; call protocol remains distinct.

seven_items.name: First-token prefill and QDQ lineage
seven_items.finding: Original AIME full prompt prefill has no quantize call. First decode consumes its unquantized state; QDQ follows each decode. Matched OLD H fixed replay skips t0 QDQ and performs255, NEW H performs256. FP restored run has no H/QDQ; successful FP does not qualify either H lineage.

seven_items.name: C128/C32 grouping axes
seven_items.finding: C128 state is[B,H,K,V]=[1,32,128,128]; amax(-2,keepdim=True) reduces all128 K entries at each V and yields[B,H,1,V]. No group32 dispatch exists in current restored worker/matched FP units. Four K groups of32 would be a distinct proposed contract, not a verified implementation; V grouping is not interchangeable.

seven_items.name: Sym/Asym scale and zero-point
seven_items.finding: Historical C128 uses EPS1e-12, scale=maxabsK/127, torch.round, clamp[-127,127], reconstructed code*scale, effective zero-point0; codes are floating temporaries and actual persistent carrier is nativeFP32. No corresponding C32 Sym/Asym source is selected by this execution. Affine range/minmax, zero-point dtype/clamp, rounding, constant groups and scale floor must be prospectively frozen; no formula is silently substituted.

seven_items.name: Next GDN consumption
seven_items.finding: Old quantize state.copy_ writes actual cache object. Native next single-token path takes cache.layers[layer].recurrent_states[0] as initial_state, runs recurrent helper, then updates actual cache by copy_. Static path is consistent with consumption; current FP capture does not dynamically verify post-QDQ next-consumption bytes/scales/code identity for an INT8 configuration.

seven_items.name: Persistent high-precision shadow
seven_items.finding: Selected C128 retains an FP32 QDQ cache carrier, not packed INT8 state. source/codes/dequant are temporary locals; no separate untouched recurrent shadow is selected by this path. A CPU-only EncodedState codec does persist physical int8+scales but is a distinct CPU representation and not the selected native GPU path. Static audit is not exhaustive runtime alias/liveness proof.

seven_items.name: Same-protocol matched baseline
seven_items.finding: Current restored measurements are FP fixed256 input,1-token chunk+255 recurrent,128warmup+128measured. A future FP/H+C128/H+C32 comparison must use the same admitted source, binary/runtime bindings, GPU, input, prefill, QDQ timing, cache lifetime, dtype and scoring protocol; long AIME prompts or historical NEW results cannot be substituted. FP short pass is conditional evidence only, not INT8/long horizon pass.
